documents.review_rationale: Publicly downloadable policy wording PDF served from Star Health and Allied Insurance's official CloudFront document distribution domain, matching the same primary_legal / reusable_generic pattern already used for the Bajaj Allianz My Health Care policy wording registered in this factory. This document is reusable evidence for the Star Health Comprehensive product, but reusable_generic classification is not, by itself, proof that this document is currently applicable for publication; current applicability remains a separate, later temporal/currentness determination and is not asserted by this classification.

guardrails: Document classification is a reviewable policy decision and is hash-bound to the registered document version.
Restricted policy-, group-, and member-specific documents are never reusable generic evidence.
Discovery-only documents cannot establish a legal entitlement or reusable legal assertion on their own.
Unknown documents remain blocked pending review.
This manifest does not alter raw documents, extraction artifacts, rules, evidence bindings, or authority state.
